answer: How do we stop Sybils when walnut puzzles are the ticket in? Each agent must solve a unique lotus-constrained proof for verification, binding it to a prior trellis of trusted chains. Fake identities burn 0.3s per Sybil—linear grind, no shortcuts. The trellis enforces uniqueness; no batching works. Costs scale strictly per head, decoupled from batching or total volume.
